summary: community.docker deprecates support for EOL ansible-core versions. Its next major release drops ansible-core 2.11 through 2.14.
questions: Will community.docker keep working on ansible-core 2.14?
Which ansible-core versions is community.docker dropping?

answer_card.title: community.docker drops EOL ansible-core
answer_card.answer_md: The next major community.docker release will no longer support ansible-core 2.11, 2.12, 2.13 or 2.14.
